Name: Random Church
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
what it does is add a church to the left of the community center, in the empty pen/fence thing.
also adds: 
An NPC
A special order
A quest
3 items or so idk i forgor💀
3 events
70+ lines of dialogue
[color=#cc4125][size=3]!!Conflicts with SVE!!![/size][/color]

Includes recolor options in the config menu, for  DaisyNiko's Earthy recolor, Retro recolor, Blue Grass recolor, and Way Back Pelican Town, if you have one of them installed and want the church to match your recolored map.
Also has seasonal variants for each recolor, changes when the season changes, or you select a different recolor. if you select a different recolor while the game is loaded up, simply leave the town and come back. it will change after that.

Content Patcher, GMCM, SMAPI, Untimed Special Orders, and Esca's Modding Plugins
